messages.author: Jatin Kashyap
messages.body:
Good Evening All,
I am trying to follow “
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/analysis/tutorial_notebooks/crystal_simulation_setup/index.html#1.-Constructing-a-lattice:-You
'll-need-some-more-tools-for-this!”.
During the initial steps when I issues “$ amber.conda install nglview==0.5.1 -c ambermd”
It returns below error:
XtalUtilities % amber.conda install nglview==0.5.1 -c ambermd
Collecting package metadata (current_repodata.json): done
Solving environment: failed with initial frozen solve. Retrying with flexible solve.
Collecting package metadata (repodata.json): done
Solving environment: failed with initial frozen solve. Retrying with flexible solve.
PackagesNotFoundError: The following packages are not available from current channels:
- nglview==0.5.1
Current channels:
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/ambermd/osx-64
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/ambermd/noarch
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/osx-64
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main/noarch
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r/osx-64
-
https://repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/r/noarch
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/osx-64
-
https://conda.anaconda.org/conda-forge/noarch
To search for alternate channels that may provide the conda package you're
looking for, navigate to
https://anaconda.org
and use the search bar at the top of the page.
Which further gives the below error open opening the notebook:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ImportError                               Traceback (most recent call last)
<ipython-input-2-609bd389c037> in <module>()
4
5
----> 6 import pytraj as pt, nglview as nv
7
8 print(pt.__version__, nv.__version__)
ImportError: No module named nglview
Can anybody help me to solve this issue as I was unable to get the solution from Archive.
Thank you.
——
Jatin Kashyap
Ph.D. Student
Dibakar Datta Group
Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering
New Jersey Institute of Technology (NJIT)
University Heights
Newark, NJ 07102-1982
Phone- (201)889-5783
Email- jk435.njit.edu
